_comment: The opposite extreme: one principal holds roles/owner. Owner expands (from the bundled role catalog) to ~13k permissions, ~4k of them with a logged method. This is the 'audit an over-privileged account' case — and the sheer size IS the finding.
_expect: account examples/accounts/02_overprivileged_owner.json  ->  loads 1 principal; needs the GCP role catalog present (falls back to a single literal grant without it)
blindspots  ->  SLOW on purpose: ~4k reachable permissions x a few hundred ms each = ~10-20 min. It's a whole-corpus audit, not an interactive call.
blindspots resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy iam.serviceAccountKeys.create  ->  scope it to specific permissions and it returns in seconds.
who resourcemanager.projects.setIamPolicy  ->  owner@demo.com holds it (through roles/owner)
name: overprivileged-owner
